g.title: jev
g.text: Jev selection, state ownership and delivery commit

g.title: enable
g.text: Explicit enable: validated owner-only key + config

g.title: context
g.text: Throughline public context: exactly 3 completed turns
1.5s command guard; read session lastTurn before judging

g.title: score
g.text: Jev jev-1.13.0: repeated problem AND clearly stuck >= .8
API receives completed conversation text; 1.5s request guard
choose at most 3 terms above none probability

g.title: error
g.text: Any invalid payload/context, key/API/DB or persistence failure
throw to host stderr catch; no fabricated failure observation
output/commit errors reach delivery stderr catch
separate writes may partially persist; no rollback claim

g.title: below
g.text: write observation delivery=none -> save session lastTurn -> null

g.title: fts
g.text: Nonempty query: local AND FTS, at most 20 candidates
finally close search DB BEFORE relevance API call
Jev receives conversation + candidate excerpts; match >= .8

g.title: generic
g.text: suppress if notifiedTerms contains query or '_none'

g.title: observation
g.text: decision / delivery / turn references / human review
Caveat does not persist raw conversation text

g.title: matched
g.text: suppress if session deliveredIds OR hook-delivery contains ID

g.title: dedupe
g.text: by the applicable ID / term check?

g.title: suppressed
g.text: then save session lastTurn -> return null; no output

g.title: pending
g.text: session cursor / delivery ID or term not yet saved

g.title: output
g.text: nonempty texts require successful stdout callback
prepared.delivered -> notice.delivered only if text included
then pending ack; host use is not proven

g.title: commit
g.text: Jev delivered callback: reload session, prepare lastTurn
matched adds ID; generic adds term
selected only: separate DB markHit, finally close

g.title: review
g.text: read observations; show evaluated denominators and reasons
